name: Will o' Wisp
original_name: ウィル・オ・ウィスプ
source:
The stage is London in the late 19th century. One day, Hanna finds two keys from her grandfather's relics. One is the key of the basement and the other one is to open a box in which a doll sleeps....

[From Himeya Shop]
